items.title: The middle factor of a composite which is flat is flat whenever the first factor is surjective and flat
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that in a composite of morphisms of algebraic stacks the middle factor is flat whenever the composite is flat and the first factor is surjective and flat (author lemma at source lines 5432-5438, label lemma-flat-permanence). The proof (source lines 5440-5452) chooses smooth covers by algebraic spaces, verifies flatness and surjectivity of the relevant covering maps from the hypotheses, and reduces to the corresponding statement for algebraic spaces (proof lines 5441-5451). The reduction through the covers is the content. H2.
